assets.name: Unit Sphere
assets.description: Analytic unit sphere centered at the origin; surface meshes and volume meshes are derived representations.

units.coordinate_system: Cartesian, right-handed, origin at sphere center

definition.notes: Surface tessellation settings belong to representation generation, not the analytic definition.

generator.name: oneflow_stl_geometry
generator.algorithm: Icosahedron with recursive four-way subdivision and radial projection

provenance.notes: This is the current reproducible generation path, not a claim about the original bytes of historical checked-in STL fixtures.

assets.name: 6:1 Prolate Spheroid
assets.description: Axis-aligned prolate spheroid centered at the origin.

units.coordinate_system: Cartesian, right-handed, origin at spheroid center

definition.notes: The 6:1 reference shape is generated by scaling unit-sphere coordinates by the semi-axes.

generator.name: oneflow_stl_geometry
generator.algorithm: Unit icosphere vertices transformed by semi-axis scale factors

provenance.notes: Current reproducible generation path; historical fixture provenance is not inferred.

assets.name: Cylinder Internal-Flow Domain
assets.description: Closed cylindrical fluid domain with wall, inlet and outlet patches.

definition.notes: Radius and length define the analytic geometry; divisions control only the surface discretization. Patches are wall, inflow and outflow.

generator.name: oneflow_stl_geometry
generator.algorithm: Shared axial rings, triangulated lateral wall and separately labeled planar end caps

provenance.notes: Canonical cylinder STL and companion patch manifest are checked in as immutable grid-database inputs. The Geometry Library generator can produce custom variants outside the source tree.

representations.notes: Canonical, version-controlled 48 x 16 surface fixture. Companion checksum and patch metadata: grid/stl_to_gmsh/3d/cylinder_internal_flow/automatic_tetrahedra/python/input/model.geometry.json. The Geometry Library can still generate custom parameterized variants into the user workspace.
Native C++ Case serialization of the same 48 x 16 analytic cylinder and wall/inflow/outflow patch partition. Its checksum is representation-specific.

assets.name: 90-Degree Circular Pipe Bend
assets.description: Parametric circular pipe with straight inlet/outlet extensions and a quarter-circle centreline bend; the enclosed region is a fluid domain.

units.coordinate_system: Cartesian, right-handed; inlet tangent +X, bend in X-Y plane

equations: P(phi,alpha) = C(phi) + r cos(alpha) N(phi) + r sin(alpha) B
V = pi r^2 (Lin + Lout + Rc theta)
definition.notes: The cross-section is swept along a continuous tangent frame. The default ratios are Rc/D=2 and Lin/D=Lout/D=3. Surface divisions are representation-generation parameters, not analytic geometry.

generator.name: oneflow_pipe_bend_geometry
generator.algorithm: Circular section swept along inlet straight, circular centreline arc and tangent outlet straight; triangulated with explicit inlet/outlet caps

provenance.notes: Python and C++17 implementations share the same analytic swept-surface definition and default parameters. Python additionally exports checksum-bound region patch files for the generic Gmsh route; C++ currently emits the ASCII STL and a parameter/patch-count report.

representations.notes: Python generator emits the closed STL, checksum-bound .geometry.json, region_manifest.json and sibling <stem>.wall.stl, <stem>.inflow.stl and <stem>.outflow.stl files. The region manifest is consumed by the existing geometry-independent region-aware Gmsh adapter.
